title: datamanifest manifest (datasets.toml) — spec-v3
description: JSON Schema for the JSON projection of a datamanifest manifest TOML file (spec-v3). Parse the TOML to JSON, then validate. _META.schema is asserted as 1. spec-v3 storage: folder variables are bare top-level roots; the datasets/ and cached/ content prefixes and the scope partition are applied by the layer and configured via [_STORAGE._PREFIX] / [_STORAGE._SCOPE]. Lenient about underscore-prefixed structural keys (preserved verbatim); rejects unknown plain dataset fields (typos).

_LOADERS.description: Language-implicit format -> binding loaders map (tolerated; the bare counterpart of [_LANG.<self>.loaders], read as the running tool's own language).

schema.description: Data-model compatibility version. This schema file targets schema 1.

binding.description: A fetcher/loader binding, used identically for per-dataset fetcher/loader and for [_LANG.<lang>.loaders] values: a bare module:function string, or a { ref, args, kwargs } table. The string is an alias for { ref } (no args/kwargs) and is the canonical written form whenever there are no arguments.

selector.description: A storage selector: a $-folder reference, optionally with a literal sub-path ($data, $scratch, $cache/sub). Bare folder names are not valid.

loaders.description: format -> binding default-loader map for this language (each value is a module:function string or a { ref, args, kwargs } table).

shell.description: The shell execution context has a fetcher only (no loader).

storageOverrides.description: _HOST (hostname glob/regex) -> { folder-name: path-expression }. _PROFILE has the same shape but is reserved (shelved) in spec-v3.

contentMap.description: Per-content-kind map for _PREFIX / _SCOPE: keys 'datasets' and 'cached' (string values; empty allowed; a _PREFIX value may be a multi-segment relative path, e.g. 'cached/2025.1').

storage.description: [_STORAGE]: folder variables (bare key -> path expression to a top-level root), the project-wide default selector, _HOST overrides, the _PREFIX content-prefix map, and the _SCOPE partition map. _PROFILE is reserved (shelved).

scope.description: Project-wide scope (both kinds; default: derived project id). '' = the unscoped/global store. Overridden per-kind by _SCOPE, and per-item by a dataset's scope field / a produced scope=.

dataset.description: A dataset table: language-agnostic contract fields plus an optional _LANG sub-table.

scope.description: Optional per-dataset partition segment (the top rung of the scope ladder); '' = the unscoped/global store, a name = that partition. Omitted = the layer default.

shell.description: Language-agnostic shell fetcher: a command template run as a subprocess (the same command for every tool). Fetcher only.

not.description: uri and uris are mutually exclusive.
